high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "The Greatest of All Time," featuring actor Vijay. The poster is designed to promote an IMAX experience of the film. Main Subject: The central figure is a man with a beard and short hair, looking upwards with a determined expression. He appears to be in a cityscape background, suggesting an urban setting. Background: The backdrop features a city skyline with tall buildings, some of which are illuminated, indicating either sunrise or sunset. There is a dramatic sky with clouds, adding to the intensity
